summary: Hero announcement pill: a gradient-highlighted label (“New”), short text and an arrow. Becomes a link with href, a button with onPress, and static text otherwise.
whenToUse: Announcing news above a hero title (call for speakers, new release, event).
Linking in one click to a page with more details.
whenNotToUse: System messages or persistent warnings: use Banner or Alert.
Status labels in tables or cards: use Badge.

props.name: badge
props.description: Highlighted label; null to hide it.

props.name: href
props.description: Destination: renders an <a href> (React Aria Link, with target, rel, routing).

props.name: onPress
props.description: Action: renders a <button>. Ignored when href is present.

props.name: tone
props.description: brand for light surfaces; inverse (glass effect, inherits the text color) for dark heroes.

inherits: Props of React Aria Link (with href), Button (with onPress) or HTML attributes of <span>; ref to the root element.

keyboard.action: Reaches the pill when it is a link or button.
Follows the link or triggers the action.

accessibility: The accessible name is the visible text: label + announcement (e.g. “New Call for Speakers 2027 open”).
Visible focus ring with --dc-color-focus-ring; in forced-colors mode a CanvasText border and LinkText text when interactive.
responsive: Text wraps inside the pill in narrow containers; the maximum width is 100% of the container.
customization: Tokens: --dc-gradient-accent and --dc-color-action-primary-foreground for the label, --dc-color-surface-brand for tone="brand".
commonMistakes: Long text: the pill is meant for a single line; details belong on the linked page.
Using tone="brand" on a dark hero: use inverse.
limits: Only one highlighted label per pill.
